verdict.rationale: ClickHouse Cloud is previewing an in-product AI agent (ClickStack AI notebooks) that can query logs/traces/metrics on the user's behalf, and a separate AI Functions/Inference Service is also in private preview — but both are waitlist-only, not generally available built-in assistants. Missing for 10: GA availability of the assistant, first-party documentation beyond waitlist pages, and independent/hands-on evidence of it actually delegating tasks.
